item.title: Young DIY investors ‘bought the dip’ during Middle East turmoil, research finds
item.summary: Younger do-it-yourself investors were far more likely than their older counterparts to buy into falling markets during the recent turbulence sparked by the Middle East conflict, according to new research from Charles Stanley Direct.
